An Inter-Departmental Board, consisting of the Secretary of War, the
Secretary of the Interior, and the Secretary of Agriculture, is hereby

useful products.

power sites in different parts of the United States for the purposes prescribed
by the statute, and will recommend a site or sites for the plant or plants
